_HOW_TO_USE: 1. Copy this whole _template folder to content/papers/YYYY-your-slug/
2. Fill in the fields below and DELETE every key starting with an underscore.
3. Replace teaser.jpg with a 16:9 image (1600x900). This file is required.
4. Optionally add teaser.mp4 (<=6s, <=2MB, silent, loops), gallery images, bibtex.txt.
The folder name is PERMANENT once published — URLs depend on it. When a preprint
becomes a journal paper, edit 'venue' in place; never make a second folder.
title: Full title exactly as published
short_title: Short name for nav and page titles
_authors: Ordered. Wrap YOUR name in ** ** so it renders bold. Add † for corresponding author.
_role: first | corresponding | contributing. 'first' = you are first author. 'corresponding' = you carry the dagger. 'contributing' = minor/middle author: the paper stays in the full archive and the theme filters but is NOT eligible for the homepage Selected list (the build enforces this).
_venue_status: one of: journal | conference | preprint | under-review | dataset
_themes: one or more of: perception | physics | embodied. Drives colour and filters.
_selected: true puts it on the homepage. Requires role 'first' or 'corresponding'. Keep the selected set to about 8.
_is_new: true shows a 'New' badge. Remember to remove it after a few months.
_page: true generates papers/<slug>/index.html. Requires 'abstract'. Use for your best work only.
_hidden: true keeps the folder in the repo but removes it from the site. For work under review.
_tldr: ONE plain-English sentence saying what changed. Highest-value field on the page.

media._teaser_video: Optional. Delete this line and the next if you have no video.
media._alt: One sentence describing the image. Accessibility and image search both use it.
media._placeholder: Set true while the teaser is a stand-in; the build will warn you. Remove when real.

_gallery: Project-page figures. Prefix filenames 01-, 02- to control order.
_links: type is one of: project paper arxiv code data video demo slides poster press. Render order is fixed by the site, not by this list. Use a url starting with # for 'not yet available'.
